description: Move Mara only through the exact exit the Adventurer just traversed, preserving physical location and authored refusal

replacements.old:
<ROUTINE V-WAIT ("OPTIONAL" (NUM 3))
	 <TELL "Time passes..." CR>
	 <REPEAT ()
		 <COND (<L? <SET NUM <- .NUM 1>> 0> <RETURN>)
		       (<CLOCKER> <RETURN>)>>
	 <SETG CLOCK-WAIT T>>
replacements.new:
<ROUTINE V-WAIT ("OPTIONAL" (NUM 3))
	 <COND (<EQUAL? ,WINNER ,MARA>
		<MARA-WAIT-HERE>)
	       (T
		<TELL "Time passes..." CR>
		<REPEAT ()
			<COND (<L? <SET NUM <- .NUM 1>> 0> <RETURN>)
			      (<CLOCKER> <RETURN>)>>
		<SETG CLOCK-WAIT T>)>>
